title: Structure engineering header
description: A fixed overlay header. Desktop: a big single-letter logo at the far left and a row of small white uppercase-mono pills 2px apart, each inverting to ink on hover in 0.25s. Phones: a black bar with a looping marquee line and a contact link pinned at its end, then the logo beside two white boxes, Menu and a shortcut; Menu opens a full-screen ink panel of large links. The logo turns white over the dark photo sections and is ink everywhere else.
notes: fixed: it overlays the page; the first section should be a full-bleed hero
the logo turns white over any section marked data-tone="dark" (the hero, statement and feature blocks set it); mark your own dark sections the same way
the white pills stay white over every section (the original turns them transparent over white sections)
name: structureengineering-header
